segments.name: Payments
segments.description: Provides software and payment processing solutions, point of sale and business intelligence tools to merchants from small businesses to large enterprises worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company's CODM is the chief executive officer, who reviews financial information on a consolidated level for purposes of allocating resources and evaluating financial performance, and as such, the Company's operations constitute one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Merchants pay processing fees based on volume or per transaction, and subscription fees for software, business intelligence tools and payment device management.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our revenue is derived from processing fees, which are charged either as a percentage of volume and/or as a fee per transaction.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired Global Blue, adding tax-free shopping, dynamic currency conversion and payments solutions to its single reportable segment.
changes.evidence: As a result of the acquisition of Global Blue Group Holding AG ("Global Blue") in the third quarter of 2025 ("Global Blue Merger") we are also a leader in tax-free shopping ("TFS").
